Automated benchmark, 3 runs each, same input/provider(codex)/criterion: native CLI 8.38/9.01/9.18s, Studio 8.55/9.79/14.8s, all correct; only Studio persisted the result. Step counts (6 vs 4) and app switches (2 vs 0) are a scripted model, not observed. Owner usability benefit is UNVERIFIED: no owner trial.

Independent non-contributing reviewer (session 2), 3 rounds: (1) 10 findings, 8 fixed and confirmed, 2 documented; (2) re-review raised 2 new low issues, 1 fixed and 1 documented; (3) review of the paid route and redesign: no key leak, no XSS/CSRF; 2 medium (byte-based reservation bound; redaction over split stream spans) and 3 low fixed with tests; 1 low accepted (the mission permit bills dev-test chat by design). No PR/merge: local repo, no remote.
